home.heroTitle: Where will your crew fly you next?
home.heroSubtitle: Describe the trip you want. Travel Crew AI picks the right specialists, checks the numbers and hands you a plan you can change.
home.step1Body: Free text, structured fields, or both. Nothing is sent to a model before the guardrails clear it.
home.step2Body: A weather question runs one agent. A full journey runs five. Nothing runs that is not needed.
home.step3Title: You review before anything is final
home.step3Body: Approve the draft, or say what to change. Only the affected parts are planned again.
home.heroEyebrow: Flights, stays, weather and budget - planned together

about.title: Your own travel crew, planning every part of the trip
about.intro: Tell us where you want to go. Travel Crew AI works out how to get there, where to stay, what to see, what the weather will be like and what it will all cost - then hands you a plan you can change before you commit to anything.

minutes.title: Plan in minutes
minutes.body: Pick a country, a city and a few preferences with a tap. No long forms.

transport.title: Every way to get there
transport.body: Flight, train, bus or car - plus CNG, auto-rickshaw and ferry for the last stretch - compared side by side.

places.title: Places worth seeing
places.body: Photos of the top sights at your destination. Tap one to add it to your must-see list.

budget.title: A budget that adds up
budget.body: Travel, stay, food and activities, totalled in your currency so you know what the trip will cost.

groups.title: Built for your group
groups.body: Solo, couple, family with children or a group of friends - the plan fits who is going.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Nothing is final until you approve it. Ask for changes and only the parts affected are redone.

language.title: In your language
language.body: Use Travel Crew AI in English, Bangla or Hindi.

save.title: Save and download
save.body: With a free account your plans are kept together, ready to copy, download or save as PDF any time.

tell.title: Tell us your trip
tell.body: Where from, where to, when, and who is coming.

crew.title: Your crew plans it
crew.body: Transport, hotels, weather, sights and budget are worked out together.

review.title: Review and adjust
review.body: Change anything you like - a cheaper hotel, a train instead of a flight.

go.title: Save it and go
go.body: Keep the final plan in your dashboard and download it for the road.

about.coverageBody: More than 30 countries across South Asia, South-East Asia, East Asia, the Middle East, Europe, North America, Africa and Australia - with especially detailed coverage of Bangladesh and India, from Cox's Bazar and Saint Martin's Island to Bandarban, Sylhet, Goa and Leh.
about.promiseBody: We tell you where every number comes from. Fares and times we estimate are clearly marked as estimates, so check them with the airline, railway or operator before you book.

free.q: Does it cost anything to plan a trip?
free.a: No. Planning a trip is free. A free account lets you save, copy and download your plans.

booking.q: Can I book through Travel Crew AI?
booking.a: Not yet. Travel Crew AI plans and compares; you book with the airline, railway, bus operator or hotel you choose.

prices.a: Where a provider gives us a live price we show it. Everything else is an estimate from distance and typical local fares, and is labelled as one.

account.q: Why do I need an account to download?
account.a: Your plan is saved to your account, so you can come back to it, download it again from your dashboard, and keep all your trips in one place.

languages.a: English, Bangla and Hindi - for the website and for your travel plan.

regions.q: My destination is not in the list - can I still plan?
regions.a: Yes. Type any city in the box. The listed places simply come with extra detail such as photos and ground-transport options.

about.contactBody: Questions, ideas or a place you would like us to add? We would love to hear from you.
